title: Promise Time Limit
summary: timeLimit(fn, t) returns an async wrapper forwarding its arguments to fn; resolves or rejects with fn's outcome if it settles within t ms, otherwise rejects with 'Time Limit Exceeded' after t ms; clears obsolete timers and avoids unhandled late rejections.
outputFormat: fn's value or rejection, or rejection 'Time Limit Exceeded'
edgeRules: late rejection must not be unhandled
timer cleared when fn settles first

examples.output: rejects with 'Time Limit Exceeded' at 100 ms
